method: open-loop scripted XInput timeline (controller_autoplay.py, in-process pad, game unfocused, 60 fps cap) while tools/native_probe/live_state.py read the player entity's world matrix (forward = row 1, position = row 3; ACU-RE-0044) and every playback leaf of the animation graph (file ID, graph weight, playback time; ACU-RE-0025/0045) with ReadProcessMemory at a nominal 30 Hz, asynchronous to the game's frames
time: t in seconds from the first input step's start; samples before it have negative t. Sample times come from QPC, input times from Unix time, joined through the probe session (minimum of time_unix - qpc/f over its events); input times may be late against samples by up to one probe poll (about 0.1 s), and across all runs the per-run offsets agree within about 0.013 s
coordinates: as recorded: Z up (ACU-RE-0044, one sample); position units presumed metres, not established; heading_deg = atan2(forward.y, forward.x)

sample_fields.step: index of the active input step or null
sample_fields.position: entity matrix row 3 (x, y, z), 4 decimals as sampled
sample_fields.forward: entity matrix row 1, 4 decimals as sampled

clip_fields.file_id: animation resource file ID (16 hex digits)
clip_fields.graph_row: index of the leaf's row in the controller's graph row array (the same file ID can play in two rows)
clip_fields.weight: graph row weight: a presence/blend input, not proven final contribution (ACU-RE-0025)
clip_fields.playback_time_s: f32 at playback +0x384 as recorded by live_state.py ('time')
clip_fields.offset: f32 at playback +0x36C as recorded by live_state.py ('offset'); meaning not established

clip_name_source: local asset index (tools/asset_query.py where), first resource row; label/confidence as given

runs.note: started where an earlier closed-loop navigate.py test in the same session left Arno, not at the pin

excluded_runs.window-sweep-1, window-sweep-2, vault-sc: closed-loop navigate.py control: the stick was re-steered every 0.1 s and not logged per frame
excluded_runs.parkour-1, parkour-2-preset, parkour-5-r: input timeline but no live_state.py transform/clip stream
excluded_runs.nav-1/idle.jsonl, nav-1/nav-test.jsonl: no input timeline recorded with them

not_established: position units (presumed metres) and full handedness (ACU-RE-0044 rests on one sample)
camera yaw: the stick is camera-relative and the camera was not recorded, so stick -> world direction is not reproducible from these inputs alone
whether root motion or simulation moves the entity, and which object owns the authoritative transform
which clip the native graph selects for an input (selection logic); graph weight vs final contribution
per-frame completeness: samples are asynchronous reads at ~25-30 Hz, not every game frame
repeatability: open-loop scripts from the same pinned start diverge (ACU-RE-0044 obs. 8); these are single runs
native tick rate and time step (60 fps cap applied by the focus shim)
